context: Saito follows up with Mei mid-pregnancy.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Warm, direct opening. Gentle and professional without distance. Steady eye contact. A doctor who asks because she wants to know the answer.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 元気ですよ、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: I'm doing well, thank you so much.
lines.style: Soft, genuine relief in the voice. Respectful but not stiff. A small warmth underneath the politeness—she feels safe here.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Your health looks good. The baby's progressing beautifully too.
lines.style: Measured reassurance. A pause before the second clause—letting the good news settle. Quiet conviction, no false cheer.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Breath of release. Quiet and tender. The words come slower, weighted with the lifting of worry. Almost to herself.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: You can call anytime if you need to talk things through.
lines.style: Soft promise, not a formality. Slight lean forward in the voice. The kind of permission that means she'll actually answer.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 一緒に、頑張ります、本当に。
lines.en: We'll do this together. I mean it.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. No performance. A small catch of emotion underneath—she's speaking as much to herself. Steady.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Take care of yourself. You matter.
lines.style: Closing warmth. Final, gentle. Not rushed. The kind of thing a good doctor says and means with her whole presence.
